# Can Fabrika

> Can Fabrika is an indie mobile game studio based in İstanbul, Türkiye (iOS and Android) making games in two lines: pixel-art tycoon/management games and party games played with friends on phones. Created by Can, a developer in Berlin who also runs the Turkish YouTube channel "Kendi Kendime Hikayeler" (31K+ subscribers). Legal entity: Yusuf Demir, sole proprietorship trading as Can Fabrika, İstanbul, Türkiye. All games are currently in development.

## Games
- [Paw & Sword](https://www.canfabrika.com/games/paw-and-sword/): Pixel-art idle tycoon RPG. A busy town of heroes who hunt monsters together, loot, raids and boss walls. For fans of Evil Hunter Tycoon and Kairosoft games.
- [REZİL](https://www.canfabrika.com/games/rezil/): 18+ party card game for phones in the spirit of Cards Against Humanity. Room codes, bots, decks written natively in 10 languages (incl. Turkish, German, English), country, expat (gurbetçi) and office decks.
- [Whisker Hollow](https://www.canfabrika.com/games/whisker-hollow/): Cozy cat-themed pixel-art town and dungeon manager. iPhone first.

## Languages
English (/), Turkish (/tr/), German (/de/), Dutch (/nl/), Danish (/da/), Swedish (/sv/), Norwegian (/no/), Finnish (/fi/), Brazilian Portuguese (/pt-br/).

## Devlog
- [Devlog index](https://www.canfabrika.com/blog/): articles by Can on how the games are designed, balanced, drawn and written. Turkish versions at https://www.canfabrika.com/tr/blog/.
- [Why I'm building Paw & Sword](https://www.canfabrika.com/blog/why-im-building-paw-and-sword/): What Evil Hunter Tycoon got right, what I want to make bigger, and why watching the battles is the real game.
- [One cat per class: designing 45 hero classes that stay recognisable](https://www.canfabrika.com/blog/one-cat-per-class-45-hero-classes/): 45 classes, 7 rank looks each, and one rule that keeps every hero recognisable from Normal to Mythic.
- [Teaching pixel cats to walk in 8 directions](https://www.canfabrika.com/blog/pixel-cats-walking-in-8-directions/): Why side-view heroes felt wrong, how five drawn views and some mirroring give eight directions, and the traps in flipping sprites.
- [Keeping sprite animations consistent: the 8-frame sheet rule](https://www.canfabrika.com/blog/consistent-sprite-animations-8-frame-rule/): Sheets of exactly eight frames, feet on one line, no size pops and an eye-colour check: the boring rules that keep hundreds of animations clean.
- [Balancing an idle tycoon with bot players](https://www.canfabrika.com/blog/balancing-an-idle-tycoon-with-bot-players/): Four bot profiles, a simulated month of play in a few minutes, and the problems they found before any human tester did.
- [The mid-game gold problem and how Hero Training fixed it](https://www.canfabrika.com/blog/mid-game-gold-problem-hero-training/): Gold was piling up with nothing to buy. Here is how a training feature with an escalating daily price gave it a job without breaking the boss walls.
- [Boss walls, the Boss Horn and losing fairly](https://www.canfabrika.com/blog/boss-walls-boss-horn-losing-fairly/): Some bosses are meant to stop you for a while. The trick is making a loss feel like information, not punishment.
- [Rare heroes on purpose: summons, pity timers and why heroes never leave](https://www.canfabrika.com/blog/rare-heroes-summons-pity-timers/): Rarity makes moments. A pity timer keeps the worst case known, and a no-leaving rule keeps the heroes you love.
- [Writing REZİL in 10 languages, from scratch](https://www.canfabrika.com/blog/writing-rezil-in-10-languages/): A translated joke keeps its meaning and loses its punch. Why every REZİL deck is written from scratch in its own language.
- [Inside a REZİL deck: what makes a card funny](https://www.canfabrika.com/blog/inside-a-rezil-deck-funny-cards/): Two prompt shapes that work, four kinds of answer that win, and how the expat and office decks are put together.
- [Small rules, big laughs: REZİL's scoring and the cut reverse round](https://www.canfabrika.com/blog/rezil-rules-scoring-reverse-round/): Why a worst-answer-wins round was cut, how points and Crowd Pick work, and why party rules should fit in one sentence.
- [One indie studio, three games: how Can Fabrika works](https://www.canfabrika.com/blog/one-indie-studio-three-games/): Two production lines, one set of tools, privacy-first defaults and one website for everything. Plus a short introduction to Whisker Hollow.
